headline: Lightning’s Brayden Point leaves game with undisclosed injury
take:
Brayden Point left Sunday's loss in Winnipeg after about five minutes, and Jon Cooper said he could miss games (Daily Faceoff). For Tampa Bay, the timing is bad on two fronts. Point was the steady one: 16 points in 17 games, and the Lightning have taken about 60% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice. His own finishing has run a little cold (1.6 goals below his chances), so the production wasn't luck carrying him.

And this team already has a Nikita Kucherov trade request hanging over every game. At 11-4-2 and 24 points, the Lightning have the record to absorb a short absence. What they don't have is an obvious second center who drives play like Point does. If this turns into weeks rather than days, watch how much more Anthony Cirelli is asked to carry.
